meaning.en: a message sent electronically from one computer to another

sentences.en: I sent you an e-mail this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上给你发了一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: Please check your e-mail for the meeting details.
sentences.zh: 请查看你的电子邮件以了解会议详情。

meaning.en: to send a message to someone electronically

sentences.en: She e-mailed me the report yesterday.
sentences.zh: 她昨天把报告用电子邮件发给了我。

sentences.en: Could you e-mail the file to the whole team?
sentences.zh: 你能把文件用电子邮件发给整个团队吗？

meaning.en: every one of two or more people or things, considered separately

sentences.en: Each student has a book.
sentences.zh: 每个学生都有一本书。

sentences.en: Each household can reduce its environmental impact by conserving water and choosing products with less packaging.
sentences.zh: 每个家庭都可以通过节约用水和选择包装较少的产品来减少对环境的影响。

meaning.en: used to show that two or more people or things do something to or with one another

sentences.en: We talked about each other at school.

meaning.en: very interested and excited by something that is going to happen or about something you want to do

sentences.en: The eager students asked many questions.
sentences.zh: 热切的学生们问了许多问题。

sentences.en: Many graduates are eager to gain practical experience before committing to a particular career path.
sentences.zh: 许多毕业生渴望先积累实践经验，再决定具体的职业道路。

meaning.zh: 鹰；雕（一种大型猛禽，有强壮的翅膀和锐利的视力）
meaning.en: a large bird of prey with strong wings and very good eyesight

sentences.en: The eagle flies high in the sky.
sentences.zh: 鹰在天空中高高飞翔。

sentences.en: Protecting mountain forests helps preserve the hunting grounds and nesting sites of the eagle.
sentences.zh: 保护山地森林有助于保全鹰的猎食区和筑巢地。

meaning.en: the part of the body used for hearing

sentences.en: My ears feel cold, so I put on a hat.
sentences.zh: 我的耳朵觉得冷，于是我戴上了帽子。

sentences.en: Regular exposure to loud music can damage the ears and lead to permanent hearing loss.
sentences.zh: 经常接触高音量音乐可能损伤耳朵，并导致永久性听力损失。

meaning.en: pain in the ear

sentences.en: I have an earache and need to see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 我耳朵疼，需要去看医生。

sentences.en: She took some medicine to relieve her earache.
sentences.zh: 她吃了些药来缓解耳痛。

meaning.en: a British nobleman of high rank, below a marquess and above a viscount

sentences.en: The earl lived in a large country house.
sentences.zh: 这位伯爵住在一座很大的乡间宅邸里。

sentences.en: In the 19th century, an earl could own thousands of acres of land.
sentences.zh: 在19世纪，一位伯爵可能拥有数千英亩土地。

meaning.en: happening or done before the usual or expected time

sentences.en: We get up early for school.
sentences.zh: 我们为了上学起得很早。

sentences.en: Early investment in childhood education can reduce inequality and improve employment prospects later in life.
sentences.zh: 及早投资幼儿教育可以减少不平等，并改善孩子成年后的就业前景。

meaning.en: to get money for work, or to gain something such as trust or respect

sentences.en: They earn money by selling bread.
sentences.zh: 他们靠卖面包挣钱。

sentences.en: Companies can earn public trust by reporting their environmental impact honestly and taking responsibility for their mistakes.
sentences.zh: 企业可以通过如实报告环境影响并为自身错误负责来赢得公众信任。

meaning.en: serious and sincere

sentences.en: He made an earnest request.
sentences.zh: 他提出了一个诚挚的请求。

sentences.en: She spoke in an earnest tone, hoping everyone would understand how much the issue mattered.
sentences.zh: 她以认真的语气讲话，希望每个人都能明白这个问题有多重要。

meaning.zh: 收入；收益（尤指劳动或经营所得）
meaning.en: money that you earn from work or business

sentences.en: He saved half his earnings to buy a bicycle.
sentences.zh: 他存下一半收入，用来买自行车。

sentences.en: Workers with unstable earnings may struggle to afford housing, even when average wages in the economy are rising.
sentences.zh: 即使整体平均工资在上涨，收入不稳定的劳动者仍可能难以负担住房费用。

meaning.en: A small device worn in or over an ear for listening

sentences.en: One earphone fell out while I was jogging.
sentences.zh: 我慢跑时，一只耳机掉了出来。

sentences.en: Students using earphones in shared study spaces can listen to educational recordings without disturbing others.
sentences.zh: 学生在公共自习空间使用耳机，可以收听教学录音而不打扰他人。

meaning.en: a piece of jewelry worn on the ear

sentences.en: She is wearing a pair of silver earrings.
sentences.zh: 她戴着一对银耳环。

sentences.en: He bought his mother a pair of gold earrings for her birthday.
sentences.zh: 他给妈妈买了一对金耳环作为生日礼物。

meaning.en: pieces of jewelry worn on the ears

sentences.en: Mum wears gold earrings today.
sentences.zh: 妈妈今天戴着金耳环。

sentences.en: She bought a pair of silver earrings for the party.
sentences.zh: 她为参加聚会买了一对银耳环。

meaning.en: the planet we live on

sentences.en: The earth goes around the sun.
sentences.zh: 地球围绕太阳转。

sentences.en: Life on earth depends on healthy ecosystems that provide clean water, food, and breathable air.
sentences.zh: 地球上的生命依赖于能够提供洁净水源、食物和可呼吸空气的健康生态系统。

meaning.en: pottery made of baked clay, typically unglazed and porous

sentences.en: The museum displays ancient earthenware from the region.
sentences.zh: 博物馆展出了该地区的古代陶器。

sentences.en: Earthenware is often used for flower pots because it allows air and moisture to pass through.
sentences.zh: 陶器常用于制作花盆，因为它能让空气和水分通过。

meaning.en: a sudden shaking of the earth's surface

sentences.en: The earthquake shakes the old houses.
sentences.zh: 地震使那些老房子摇晃起来。

sentences.en: Strict building regulations can significantly reduce the risk of injury when an earthquake strikes a densely populated city.
sentences.zh: 当地震袭击人口稠密的城市时，严格的建筑法规可以显著降低人员受伤的风险。

meaning.en: a long, soft worm that lives in soil

sentences.en: An earthworm wriggled out of the wet garden soil.
sentences.zh: 一条蚯蚓从花园湿润的泥土中蠕动着钻了出来。

sentences.en: Earthworms improve soil structure by creating tunnels that allow air and water to move more freely.
sentences.zh: 蚯蚓通过挖掘通道，让空气和水更自由地流动，从而改善土壤结构。

meaning.en: to make something less severe or painful

sentences.en: The medicine will ease the pain.
sentences.zh: 这种药会减轻疼痛。

sentences.en: Improving public transport could ease traffic congestion while making employment opportunities more accessible to suburban residents.
sentences.zh: 改善公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，同时让郊区居民更容易获得就业机会。

meaning.en: with little trouble or effort

sentences.en: Students can easily learn the word from this book.
sentences.zh: 学生可以轻松地从这本书里学会这个单词。

sentences.en: Public information should be presented clearly so that people with different literacy levels can easily understand it.
sentences.zh: 公共信息应清晰呈现，让识字水平不同的人都能轻松理解。

meaning.en: the direction of sunrise; the eastern part of an area

sentences.en: Our kitchen window faces east, so we get the morning sun.
sentences.zh: 我们厨房的窗户朝东，所以能照到早晨的阳光。

sentences.en: Investment in rail connections could improve access to employment for communities in the east of the country.
sentences.zh: 投资铁路交通可以让该国东部地区的居民更容易获得就业机会。

meaning.en: in or towards the east

sentences.en: They live on the east side of the city.
sentences.zh: 他们住在城市的东边。

meaning.en: A Christian festival celebrating the resurrection of Jesus Christ.

sentences.en: We decorated eggs for Easter.
sentences.zh: 我们为复活节装饰了彩蛋。

sentences.en: During Easter, many destinations attract additional visitors through seasonal events, creating temporary employment in the tourism sector.
sentences.zh: 复活节期间，许多旅游目的地通过节庆活动吸引更多游客，为旅游业创造临时就业机会。

meaning.en: located toward the east

sentences.en: They live on the eastern coast.
sentences.zh: 他们住在东海岸。

sentences.en: Improved railway connections could help eastern regions attract investment and reduce economic differences within the country.
sentences.zh: 改善铁路连接有助于东部地区吸引投资，缩小国内经济差距。

meaning.en: Towards the east; moving or facing east.

sentences.en: We drove eastward until the morning light warmed our faces.
sentences.zh: 我们开车向东行驶，直到晨光暖暖地照在脸上。

sentences.en: The city's eastward expansion has increased demand for public transport and placed pressure on surrounding farmland.
sentences.zh: 这座城市向东扩张，增加了公共交通需求，也给周边农田带来了压力。

meaning.en: towards the east

sentences.en: The ship sailed eastwards along the coast.
sentences.zh: 那艘船沿着海岸向东航行。

sentences.en: After leaving the city, the road turns eastwards and follows the river.
sentences.zh: 离开城市后，这条路转向东，沿着河延伸。

meaning.en: not hard to do or understand

sentences.en: This puzzle is very easy.
sentences.zh: 这个拼图很容易。

sentences.en: Providing easy access to reliable health information can help people make better decisions about their lifestyles.
sentences.zh: 让人们方便地获取可靠的健康信息，有助于他们作出更好的生活方式选择。

meaning.en: relaxed and not easily upset or worried

sentences.en: Our easy-going neighbour never complains when our dog barks.
sentences.zh: 我们随和的邻居从不因我们的狗叫而抱怨。

sentences.en: Although an easy-going management style can reduce workplace stress, clear expectations remain essential for maintaining productivity.
sentences.zh: 虽然随和的管理风格能减轻职场压力，但明确的要求对保持生产力仍然至关重要。

meaning.en: relaxed and not easily worried or angered

sentences.en: My easygoing neighbor never complains about noise.
sentences.zh: 我那随和的邻居从不抱怨噪音。

sentences.en: Her easygoing attitude helps her handle stressful situations calmly.
sentences.zh: 她随和的态度帮助她冷静应对压力大的情况。

meaning.en: to put food in your mouth and chew

sentences.en: We eat rice for lunch.
sentences.zh: 我们午饭吃米饭。

sentences.en: Schools can encourage children to eat more vegetables by providing affordable meals with a variety of fresh ingredients.
sentences.zh: 学校可以提供价格实惠、包含多种新鲜食材的餐食，鼓励孩子多吃蔬菜。

meaning.en: the activity of taking food into your body

sentences.en: Healthy eating starts with small changes to your meals.
sentences.zh: 健康饮食始于对日常餐食的小调整。

sentences.en: Schools can encourage healthy eating by providing balanced lunches and teaching children how to prepare simple meals.
sentences.zh: 学校可以通过提供营养均衡的午餐并教孩子制作简单餐食来鼓励健康饮食。

meaning.en: to listen secretly to other people's private conversation

sentences.en: Do not eavesdrop on their talk.
sentences.zh: 不要偷听他们的谈话。

sentences.en: She was caught eavesdropping outside the meeting room.
sentences.zh: 她在会议室外面偷听时被发现了。

meaning.en: to flow away (of the tide); to gradually decrease or weaken

sentences.en: The tide began to ebb.
sentences.zh: 潮水开始退去。

sentences.en: Public support for the policy is beginning to ebb.
sentences.zh: 公众对该政策的支持开始减弱。

meaning.en: strange or unusual in behavior

sentences.en: The eccentric artist wears bright hats.
sentences.zh: 那位古怪的艺术家戴着鲜艳的帽子。

sentences.en: His eccentric habits made him a memorable figure in the small town.
sentences.zh: 他古怪的习惯使他成为小镇上令人难忘的人物。

meaning.zh: 基督教教会的；神职人员的
meaning.en: relating to the Christian Church or its clergy

sentences.en: He wore an ecclesiastical robe.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件教会法衣。

sentences.en: The building reflects the ecclesiastical architecture of the medieval period.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑体现了中世纪时期的教会建筑风格。

meaning.en: a sound that is heard again after it has been reflected off a surface

sentences.en: We heard an echo in the empty hall.
sentences.zh: 我们在空荡荡的大厅里听到了回声。

sentences.en: The echo of her footsteps faded as she walked farther down the tunnel.
sentences.zh: 当她沿着隧道越走越远时，她脚步声的回响渐渐消失了。

meaning.zh: 兼收并蓄的；博采众长的
meaning.en: taking ideas or styles from many different sources

sentences.en: Her taste in music is eclectic.
sentences.zh: 她的音乐品味兼收并蓄。

sentences.en: The gallery's collection is eclectic, ranging from ancient pottery to modern digital art.
sentences.zh: 这家画廊的收藏博采众长，从古代陶器到现代数字艺术都有。

meaning.en: a short period when all or part of the sun or moon becomes dark

sentences.en: We watched a solar eclipse with special glasses.
sentences.zh: 我们戴着专用眼镜观看了一场日食。

sentences.en: Investment in digital services may eclipse spending on traditional infrastructure as economies become increasingly dependent on technology.
sentences.zh: 随着经济日益依赖科技，数字服务投资可能超过传统基础设施支出。

meaning.en: relating to the relationship between living things and their environment

sentences.en: We must protect our ecological system.
sentences.zh: 我们必须保护我们的生态系统。

sentences.en: The dam has caused serious ecological damage to the river.
sentences.zh: 这座大坝对河流造成了严重的生态破坏。

meaning.en: the scientific study of the relationships between living things and their environment

sentences.en: She studies ecology at university.
sentences.zh: 她在大学学习生态学。

sentences.en: Understanding forest ecology can help governments protect wildlife while managing natural resources more effectively.
sentences.zh: 了解森林生态有助于政府在更有效地管理自然资源的同时保护野生动物。

meaning.en: Relating to trade, industry, money, or the study of these.

sentences.en: The news discussed economic problems affecting local shops.
sentences.zh: 新闻讨论了影响当地商店的经济问题。

sentences.en: Investment in public transport can support economic growth by connecting workers with a wider range of jobs.
sentences.zh: 投资公共交通能让劳动者获得更广泛的就业机会，从而促进经济增长。

meaning.en: using money, time, or resources efficiently; not wasteful

sentences.en: This small car is economical to drive.
sentences.zh: 这辆小汽车开起来很省钱。

sentences.en: The new heating system is more economical because it uses less electricity.
sentences.zh: 新的供暖系统更节约，因为它耗电更少。

meaning.en: in a way relating to money, trade, or the economy

sentences.en: The town depends economically on its busy fishing harbour.
sentences.zh: 这个小镇在经济上依赖其繁忙的渔港。

sentences.en: Renewable energy projects are becoming economically viable as production costs fall and demand for cleaner electricity rises.
sentences.zh: 随着生产成本下降及清洁电力需求上升，可再生能源项目正变得在经济上可行。

meaning.en: The study of how societies produce, distribute, and use resources.

sentences.en: My sister studies economics and likes discussing food prices.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐学经济学，喜欢讨论食品价格。

sentences.en: Studying economics helps students understand how government policies influence employment, inflation, and the distribution of wealth.
sentences.zh: 学习经济学有助于学生理解政府政策如何影响就业、通货膨胀和财富分配。

meaning.en: a person who studies economics or is an expert in it

sentences.en: An economist studies money and trade.
sentences.zh: 经济学家研究货币和贸易。

sentences.en: The economist warned that rising prices could slow economic growth.
sentences.zh: 这位经济学家警告说，物价上涨可能会减缓经济增长。

meaning.en: the system of trade and industry by which a country's money is made

sentences.en: A strong economy helps the town.
sentences.zh: 强劲的经济有助于这个城镇的发展。

sentences.en: Investing in renewable energy can strengthen the economy while reducing dependence on imported fuels.
sentences.zh: 投资可再生能源可以增强经济实力，同时减少对进口燃料的依赖。

meaning.en: all the living things in an area together with the physical environment they interact with

sentences.en: Fish are part of this river ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 鱼类是这条河流生态系统的一部分。

sentences.en: Removing a single species can disrupt an entire ecosystem because organisms depend on one another for survival.
sentences.zh: 移除一个物种可能扰乱整个生态系统，因为生物依赖彼此才能生存。

meaning.en: a feeling of very great joy or excitement

sentences.en: She was in ecstasy after the win.
sentences.zh: 获胜后她欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: The crowd erupted in ecstasy when the final goal was scored.
sentences.zh: 终场进球时，人群爆发出狂喜。

meaning.en: a circular movement of water or air that is away from the main current

sentences.en: A fallen leaf spun in an eddy beside the bridge.
sentences.zh: 一片落叶在桥边的漩涡中打转。

sentences.en: Small eddies behind river barriers can trap floating waste and affect the movement of aquatic organisms.
sentences.zh: 河流障碍物后的小漩涡会困住漂浮垃圾，并影响水生生物的移动。

meaning.en: the outer or furthest point or part of something

sentences.en: Do not stand at the edge of the rock.
sentences.zh: 不要站在岩石边缘。

sentences.en: Practical experience can give graduates an edge over other candidates in a competitive job market.
sentences.zh: 在竞争激烈的就业市场中，实践经验能让毕业生比其他求职者更有优势。

meaning.en: Safe or suitable to eat.

sentences.en: These edible flowers make the salad look especially colourful.
sentences.zh: 这些可食用的花让沙拉显得格外缤纷。

sentences.en: Redistributing edible food that shops would otherwise discard could reduce waste and support families on low incomes.
sentences.zh: 将商店原本会丢弃的可食用食物重新分配，可以减少浪费并帮助低收入家庭。

meaning.en: a large impressive building

sentences.en: The old edifice still stands.
sentences.zh: 那座古老的大厦依然矗立着。

sentences.en: The cathedral is a magnificent edifice that attracts thousands of visitors every year.
sentences.zh: 这座大教堂是一座宏伟的建筑，每年吸引成千上万的游客。

meaning.en: to change, remove, or add parts of a text, film, etc.

sentences.en: Please edit this short story.
sentences.zh: 请修改这篇短篇小说。

sentences.en: Students should learn to edit their essays carefully, checking both the structure and the accuracy of their arguments.
sentences.zh: 学生应学会仔细修改论文，检查论证的结构与准确性。

meaning.en: Preparing writing, images, or recordings by correcting and arranging them.

sentences.en: Editing these holiday videos took me all afternoon.
sentences.zh: 剪辑这些假期视频花了我整整一个下午。

sentences.en: Careful editing helps researchers present complex findings clearly and makes academic articles easier to understand.
sentences.zh: 仔细编辑有助于研究人员清晰地呈现复杂的发现，也让学术文章更易理解。

meaning.en: a particular form or version of a published text, especially a book or newspaper

sentences.en: I bought a new edition of the dictionary.
sentences.zh: 我买了这本词典的新版本。

sentences.en: The revised edition of the textbook includes recent research on renewable energy and sustainable urban development.
sentences.zh: 这本教材的修订版收录了关于可再生能源和城市可持续发展的最新研究。

meaning.en: a person whose job is to edit texts, images, or sound files, especially for a newspaper, magazine, or book

sentences.en: The editor checked the news story.
sentences.zh: 编辑检查了这篇新闻报道。

sentences.en: A newspaper editor must balance the public's right to information with respect for individual privacy.
sentences.zh: 报纸编辑必须在公众知情权与尊重个人隐私之间取得平衡。

meaning.en: relating to the editing of a newspaper, magazine, etc., or to an editorial

sentences.en: She works on the editorial team of a local newspaper.
sentences.zh: 她在一家地方报纸的编辑团队工作。

sentences.en: The editorial policy of the magazine reflects its commitment to independent journalism.
sentences.zh: 该杂志的编辑方针体现了其对独立新闻的承诺。

meaning.en: a newspaper article written by or on behalf of an editor that gives an opinion on a topical issue

sentences.en: The newspaper published an editorial criticizing the new policy.
sentences.zh: 该报发表了一篇批评新政策的社论。

sentences.en: Her editorial in the latest issue sparked a heated debate among readers.
sentences.zh: 她在最新一期上的社论在读者中引发了激烈的辩论。

meaning.en: to teach someone knowledge or skills

sentences.en: Teachers educate children at school.
sentences.zh: 老师在学校教育孩子。

sentences.en: Public health campaigns should educate people about nutrition rather than simply encourage them to lose weight.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生宣传活动应向人们普及营养知识，而不只是鼓励他们减重。

meaning.en: the activity of learning or teaching

sentences.en: Good education helps children grow.
sentences.zh: 良好的教育有助于孩子成长。

sentences.en: Access to quality education can improve employment prospects and reduce inequality across different social groups.
sentences.zh: 获得优质教育的机会能够改善就业前景，并缩小不同社会群体之间的不平等。

meaning.en: relating to education, or providing useful knowledge or information

sentences.en: The museum offers many educational programs for children.
sentences.zh: 这家博物馆为孩子们提供了许多教育项目。

sentences.en: The documentary was both entertaining and educational.
sentences.zh: 这部纪录片既有趣又有教育意义。

meaning.en: a person who teaches or is involved in education

sentences.en: She is a famous educator who has written many books on teaching.
sentences.zh: 她是一位著名的教育家，写了许多关于教学的书籍。

sentences.en: The conference brought together educators from all over the country to discuss new teaching methods.
sentences.zh: 这次会议汇集了来自全国各地的教育工作者，讨论新的教学方法。

meaning.en: a long thin fish that looks like a snake

sentences.en: The eel swims in the river.
sentences.zh: 鳗鱼在河里游动。

sentences.en: Eels are often served grilled in Japanese restaurants.
sentences.zh: 在日本餐厅里，鳗鱼常被烤制后食用。

meaning.zh: 怪异的；令人毛骨悚然的
meaning.en: strange and frightening in a mysterious way

sentences.en: An eerie silence filled the old house.
sentences.zh: 那座老房子里弥漫着一种诡异的寂静。

sentences.en: The fog gave the empty street an eerie glow under the streetlights.
sentences.zh: 雾气让空荡的街道在路灯下泛着一种诡异的光。

meaning.en: a change that happens because of something

sentences.en: The sun has a good effect on plants.
sentences.zh: 阳光对植物有良好的影响。

sentences.en: Higher parking charges may have little effect on traffic unless reliable public transport is also available.
sentences.zh: 如果没有可靠的公共交通，提高停车费对交通状况的影响可能很小。

meaning.en: having the effect you want

sentences.en: This medicine is effective for a cough.
sentences.zh: 这种药对咳嗽有效。

sentences.en: Effective environmental policies should combine clear regulations with financial incentives that encourage businesses to reduce waste.
sentences.zh: 有效的环境政策应将明确的法规与鼓励企业减少废弃物的经济激励相结合。

meaning.en: in a way that achieves the intended result

sentences.en: This simple brush cleans muddy shoes surprisingly effectively.
sentences.zh: 这把简单的刷子清理沾泥的鞋子，效果出奇地好。

sentences.en: Schools can reduce waste effectively by encouraging students to reuse materials during classroom activities.
sentences.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生在课堂活动中重复使用材料，从而有效减少浪费。

meaning.en: the degree to which something produces the intended result

sentences.en: I was surprised by the effectiveness of this cleaner.
sentences.zh: 这种清洁剂的效果让我很惊讶。

sentences.en: Researchers should evaluate the effectiveness of educational programmes before recommending their adoption across the national school system.
sentences.zh: 研究人员应先评估教育项目的成效，再建议在全国学校系统中推广。

meaning.en: the ability to produce the intended result

sentences.en: They tested the efficacy of the drug.
sentences.zh: 他们测试了这种药的功效。

sentences.en: Several studies have questioned the long-term efficacy of the treatment.
sentences.zh: 多项研究对该疗法的长期效力提出了质疑。

meaning.en: The ability to achieve results without wasting time, energy, or resources

sentences.en: Organising my tools improved the efficiency of my work.
sentences.zh: 把工具整理好提高了我的工作效率。

sentences.en: Improving energy efficiency in public buildings can reduce government spending and lower greenhouse gas emissions.
sentences.zh: 提高公共建筑的能源利用效率，可以减少政府开支并降低温室气体排放。

meaning.en: working well and not wasting time, energy, or resources

sentences.en: This is an efficient way to clean.
sentences.zh: 这是一种高效的清洁方式。

sentences.en: An efficient public transport network allows cities to move more people while consuming less energy.
sentences.zh: 高效的公共交通网络使城市能够以更低的能耗运送更多乘客。

meaning.en: in a way that works well without wasting time, energy, or resources

sentences.en: She answered efficiently during the interview.
sentences.zh: 她在面试中高效地回答了问题。

sentences.en: The new software helps us manage our projects more efficiently.
sentences.zh: 这款新软件帮助我们更高效地管理项目。

meaning.en: energy or attempt used to achieve something

sentences.en: It takes effort to climb the hill.
sentences.zh: 爬这座山需要费些力气。

sentences.en: Reducing household waste requires a joint effort from consumers, manufacturers and local authorities to change everyday practices.
sentences.zh: 减少家庭垃圾需要消费者、制造商和地方政府共同努力，改变日常做法。

meaning.zh: 平等主义的；主张人人平等的
meaning.en: believing that all people are equal and should have the same rights and opportunities

sentences.en: She has egalitarian views.
sentences.zh: 她持有平等主义的观点。

sentences.en: The reform aimed to create a more egalitarian society.
sentences.zh: 这项改革旨在创建一个更加平等的社会。

meaning.en: an oval object with a shell, laid by a bird, especially a hen, eaten as food

sentences.en: I eat an egg for breakfast.
sentences.zh: 我早餐吃一个鸡蛋。

sentences.en: Eggs provide an affordable source of protein and can form part of a balanced diet.
sentences.zh: 鸡蛋是价格实惠的蛋白质来源，可以成为均衡饮食的一部分。

meaning.en: a vegetable with a smooth purple skin and soft white flesh

sentences.en: Mum fries eggplant for dinner.
sentences.zh: 妈妈晚餐做炸茄子。

sentences.en: Eggplant is often used in Mediterranean cooking, such as in ratatouille.
sentences.zh: 茄子常用于地中海料理，例如普罗旺斯炖菜。

meaning.en: a person's sense of self-esteem or self-importance

sentences.en: His ego was hurt when he lost the game.
sentences.zh: 他输了比赛，自尊心受到了伤害。

sentences.en: She has a big ego and rarely admits her mistakes.
sentences.zh: 她自尊心很强，很少承认错误。

meaning.en: a country in North Africa

sentences.en: Egypt is famous for its ancient pyramids.
sentences.zh: 埃及以其古老的金字塔而闻名。

sentences.en: The Nile River flows through Egypt and has supported agriculture for thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 尼罗河流经埃及，数千年来一直支撑着当地的农业。

meaning.zh: 埃及的；埃及人的；埃及文化的
meaning.en: relating to Egypt, its people, or its culture

sentences.en: We saw ancient Egyptian pottery in the museum yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我们昨天在博物馆欣赏了古埃及陶器。

sentences.en: Ancient Egyptian irrigation systems demonstrate how communities adapted farming practices to seasonal changes in river levels.
sentences.zh: 古埃及的灌溉系统展示了当地居民如何调整耕作方式，以适应河流水位的季节性变化。

meaning.en: the number 8

sentences.en: There are eight students in the classroom.
sentences.zh: 教室里有八名学生。

sentences.en: The meeting will start at eight o'clock.
sentences.zh: 会议将在八点开始。

meaning.en: the number 18

sentences.en: We baked eighteen muffins for the picnic this morning.
sentences.zh: 我们今天早上为野餐烤了十八个松饼。

sentences.en: In many countries, citizens gain the right to vote when they reach the age of eighteen.
sentences.zh: 在许多国家，公民年满十八岁便获得投票权。

meaning.en: coming after the seventeenth and before the nineteenth

sentences.en: This is her eighteenth birthday.
sentences.zh: 这是她的十八岁生日。

sentences.en: The eighteenth century saw many important scientific discoveries.
sentences.zh: 十八世纪见证了许多重要的科学发现。

meaning.en: coming after the seventh and before the ninth

sentences.en: Our apartment is on the eighth floor of this building.
sentences.zh: 我们的公寓在这栋楼的八楼。

sentences.en: The survey ranked public transport eighth among the factors influencing where young professionals choose to live.
sentences.zh: 调查显示，在影响年轻专业人士居住地点选择的因素中，公共交通排在第八位。

meaning.en: one of eight equal parts of something

sentences.en: She divided the cake into eighths so everyone could have a piece.
sentences.zh: 她把蛋糕分成八份，这样每个人都能分到一块。

meaning.en: the number 80

sentences.en: There are eighty students in the hall.
sentences.zh: 大厅里有八十名学生。

sentences.en: The temperature rose to eighty degrees by noon.
sentences.zh: 到中午时气温升到了八十度。

meaning.en: one or the other of two things or people

sentences.en: You may choose either apple.
sentences.zh: 两个苹果你可以任选一个。

sentences.en: Students can choose either vocational training or university education, depending on their interests and career goals.
sentences.zh: 学生可以根据自己的兴趣和职业目标，选择职业培训或大学教育。

meaning.en: to force someone or something to leave a place, or to make something come out

sentences.en: The guard will eject rude fans.
sentences.zh: 保安会把粗鲁的球迷驱逐出去。

sentences.en: The machine automatically ejects the disc after a few seconds.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟后，机器会自动弹出光盘。

meaning.en: complicated and detailed

sentences.en: They built an elaborate model of the city.
sentences.zh: 他们制作了一个精巧复杂的城市模型。

sentences.en: Governments sometimes develop elaborate plans for educational reform without consulting the teachers who will implement them.
sentences.zh: 政府有时会制定复杂的教育改革方案，却不征询负责实施这些方案的教师的意见。

meaning.en: in a detailed and complicated way; with great care and complexity

sentences.en: She answered elaborately during the interview.
sentences.zh: 她在面试中详尽地回答了问题。

sentences.en: The wedding cake was elaborately decorated with sugar flowers.
sentences.zh: 婚礼蛋糕用糖花精心装饰。

meaning.en: The addition of details to explain or develop something.

sentences.en: Your plan sounds promising but needs a little elaboration.
sentences.zh: 你的计划听起来不错，但还需要补充一些细节。

sentences.en: Further elaboration on the proposed transport policy would help residents understand how their daily journeys might change.
sentences.zh: 进一步阐述拟议的交通政策，有助于居民了解日常出行可能发生的变化。

meaning.en: for a period of time to pass

sentences.en: Several minutes elapsed before the bus finally arrived.
sentences.zh: 过了几分钟，公交车终于来了。

sentences.en: Several years may elapse before environmental policies produce measurable improvements in urban air quality.
sentences.zh: 环境政策可能要经过数年才能使城市空气质量出现可衡量的改善。

meaning.en: able to stretch and return to its original shape

sentences.en: This band is very elastic.
sentences.zh: 这条带子很有弹性。

sentences.en: Manufacturers use elastic materials in sports clothing to improve comfort and allow greater freedom of movement.
sentences.zh: 制造商在运动服中使用弹性材料，以提高舒适度，让活动更加自如。

meaning.en: a piece of elastic material, often used to stretch and hold things

sentences.en: She tied her hair with a red elastic.
sentences.zh: 她用一根红色橡皮筋扎头发。

meaning.zh: 兴高采烈的；欣喜若狂的
meaning.en: Extremely happy and excited, especially after success or good news.

sentences.en: Lina was elated when she finally passed her driving test.
sentences.zh: 莉娜终于通过驾照考试时，欣喜万分。

sentences.en: Graduates may feel elated after securing their first job, although adjusting to workplace expectations can be challenging.
sentences.zh: 毕业生找到第一份工作后可能欣喜万分，尽管适应职场要求并不容易。

meaning.en: the joint between the upper and lower parts of the arm

sentences.en: I hit my elbow on the kitchen door.
sentences.zh: 我的胳膊肘撞到了厨房门上。

sentences.en: She rested her elbows on the table while listening.
sentences.zh: 她听的时候把胳膊肘撑在桌子上。

meaning.en: to push someone with your elbow, especially to move past them

sentences.en: He elbowed his way through the crowd.
sentences.zh: 他用胳膊肘推开人群挤了过去。

sentences.en: Passengers sometimes elbow their way onto crowded trains, making public transport uncomfortable for others.
sentences.zh: 乘客有时用肘推挤着登上拥挤的列车，让其他人乘车时感到不适。

meaning.zh: 年龄较大的，年长的（尤指家庭成员之间）
meaning.en: older, especially used of family members

sentences.en: My elder sister taught me how to ride a bike.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐教会了我骑自行车。

sentences.en: Community elders can help preserve local traditions by sharing their knowledge and experiences with younger generations.
sentences.zh: 社区长者可以通过向年轻一代分享知识和经历，帮助传承当地传统。

meaning.en: old; (of people) rather old

sentences.en: An elderly man sits on the bench.
sentences.zh: 一位年长的男子坐在长椅上。

sentences.en: Cities should provide accessible public transport so that elderly residents can remain active and independent.
sentences.zh: 城市应提供无障碍公共交通，让老年居民能够保持活跃并独立生活。

meaning.zh: 最年长的；（尤指子女中）年龄最大的
meaning.en: oldest, especially of the children in a family

sentences.en: She is the eldest child at home.
sentences.zh: 她是家里最大的孩子。

sentences.en: As the eldest of three sisters, she often looked after the younger ones.
sentences.zh: 作为三姐妹中最年长的一个，她常常照顾妹妹们。

meaning.en: to choose someone to do a particular job by voting for them

sentences.en: People elect a new mayor every four years.
sentences.zh: 人们每四年选举一位新市长。

sentences.en: Citizens should elect representatives who are willing to address long-term environmental challenges rather than seek immediate popularity.
sentences.zh: 公民应当选举愿意应对长期环境挑战的代表，而不是追求眼前人气的人。

meaning.en: the process of choosing a person for a political position by voting

sentences.en: The election will take place in May.
sentences.zh: 选举将在五月举行。

sentences.en: A fair election requires transparent procedures and equal opportunities for candidates to present their policies.
sentences.zh: 公平的选举需要透明的程序，并让候选人有平等机会介绍其政策。

meaning.en: chosen or available to be chosen, not required

sentences.en: Art is an elective class.
sentences.zh: 美术是一门选修课。

sentences.en: Students can take elective courses outside their major to broaden their knowledge.
sentences.zh: 学生可以选修专业以外的课程来拓宽知识面。

meaning.zh: 选民（全体有选举权的人）
meaning.en: all the people in a country or area who are entitled to vote in an election

sentences.en: The electorate chose a new leader.
sentences.zh: 选民选出了一位新领导人。

sentences.en: Politicians must listen to the concerns of the electorate, especially during an election campaign.
sentences.zh: 政客必须倾听选民的关切，尤其是在竞选期间。

meaning.en: using or powered by electricity

sentences.en: Our electric kettle can boil water in two minutes.
sentences.zh: 我们的电水壶两分钟就能把水烧开。

sentences.en: Electric buses can reduce urban air pollution, especially when their power comes from renewable sources.
sentences.zh: 电动公交车可以减少城市空气污染，尤其是在使用可再生能源供电时。

meaning.en: relating to electricity or using electricity

sentences.en: The electrical fault left our kitchen in darkness.
sentences.zh: 电路故障让我们的厨房一片漆黑。

sentences.en: Regular inspections of electrical equipment can reduce fire risks in crowded residential buildings and workplaces.
sentences.zh: 定期检查电气设备可以降低人口密集的住宅楼和工作场所的火灾风险。

meaning.en: Someone trained to install and repair electrical systems.

sentences.en: The electrician fixed the broken light in our kitchen.
sentences.zh: 电工修好了我们厨房里坏掉的灯。

sentences.en: Training more qualified electricians is essential as households increasingly adopt solar panels and electric vehicle charging equipment.
sentences.zh: 随着越来越多家庭安装太阳能板和电动汽车充电设备，培养更多合格电工至关重要。

meaning.en: energy used for heating, lighting, and powering machines

sentences.en: The storm cut the electricity.
sentences.zh: 暴风雨导致停电了。

sentences.en: Generating electricity from renewable sources can reduce dependence on fossil fuels and lower greenhouse gas emissions.
sentences.zh: 利用可再生能源发电可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低温室气体排放。

meaning.en: to supply with electricity; to make something work by electricity

sentences.en: The new railway line will electrify the whole region.
sentences.zh: 这条新铁路线将使整个地区实现电气化。

sentences.en: Engineers plan to electrify the bus fleet to reduce air pollution.
sentences.zh: 工程师计划让公交车队电气化，以减少空气污染。

meaning.en: to make someone feel very excited

sentences.en: The crowd was electrified by the singer's performance.
sentences.zh: 歌手的表演让观众激动不已。

sentences.en: Her speech electrified the audience and inspired many young people.
sentences.zh: 她的演讲让听众振奋，并激励了许多年轻人。

meaning.en: a conductor through which electricity enters or leaves a substance or device

sentences.en: The electrode is connected to the battery.
sentences.zh: 电极与电池相连。

sentences.en: In this experiment, a carbon electrode is used to measure the current.
sentences.zh: 在这个实验中，使用碳电极来测量电流。

meaning.en: a very small particle with a negative electric charge that is part of an atom

sentences.en: An electron is a tiny part of an atom.
sentences.zh: 电子是原子的一个微小组成部分。

sentences.en: Understanding how electrons move through materials is essential for developing more efficient batteries and electronic devices.
sentences.zh: 了解电子如何在材料中移动，对开发效率更高的电池和电子设备至关重要。

meaning.en: using or relating to electronic equipment or technology

sentences.en: An electronic toy needs batteries.
sentences.zh: 电子玩具需要电池。

sentences.en: Electronic health records can help doctors share information efficiently, but strong safeguards are needed to protect patient privacy.
sentences.zh: 电子健康档案能帮助医生高效共享信息，但必须采取有力措施保护患者隐私。

meaning.en: the study and use of electronic circuits and devices

sentences.en: My sister studies electronics and repairs radios at home.
sentences.zh: 姐姐学习电子技术，在家修理收音机。

sentences.en: Advances in electronics have enabled hospitals to monitor patients more accurately and provide faster treatment.
sentences.zh: 电子技术的进步使医院能够更准确地监测患者状况，并更快地提供治疗。

meaning.en: the quality of being graceful and stylish in appearance or manner

sentences.en: The old hotel is known for its elegance.
sentences.zh: 这家老酒店以其优雅而闻名。

sentences.en: She admired the quiet elegance of the simple black dress.
sentences.zh: 她欣赏那条简洁黑裙的素雅之美。

meaning.en: attractive and showing a good sense of style

sentences.en: She wore an elegant black dress.
sentences.zh: 她穿着一条优雅的黑色连衣裙。

sentences.en: The architect proposed an elegant solution that improved ventilation without increasing the building's energy consumption.
sentences.zh: 建筑师提出了一个简洁巧妙的方案，在不增加建筑能耗的情况下改善通风。

meaning.en: a part or component of something

sentences.en: Water is an important element here.
sentences.zh: 水在这里是一个重要要素。

sentences.en: Public trust is an essential element of any successful policy aimed at improving community health.
sentences.zh: 公众信任是任何旨在改善社区健康的政策取得成功的必要因素。

meaning.zh: 基本的；根本的；自然力般的
meaning.en: Relating to the most basic features or forces of something.

sentences.en: The storm awakened an elemental fear deep inside me.
sentences.zh: 暴风雨唤起了我内心深处最本能的恐惧。

sentences.en: Access to food and shelter addresses elemental human needs that economic policy should never overlook.
sentences.zh: 获得食物和住所满足了基本的人类需求，经济政策绝不应忽视这些需求。

meaning.en: basic, simple, or at the introductory level

sentences.en: This is an elementary English book.
sentences.zh: 这是一本初级英语书。

sentences.en: Elementary education should develop children's curiosity as well as their ability to read and calculate.
sentences.zh: 小学教育不仅应培养儿童的阅读和计算能力，还应激发他们的好奇心。

meaning.en: a very large grey animal with a long trunk and tusks

sentences.en: The elephant has a long nose.
sentences.zh: 大象有一个长鼻子。

sentences.en: Protecting elephant habitats requires cooperation between conservation organisations, local communities, and governments across national borders.
sentences.zh: 保护大象栖息地需要保护组织、当地社区和各国政府开展跨国合作。

meaning.en: To move something to a higher physical position

sentences.en: The nurse used a pillow to elevate my ankle.
sentences.zh: 护士用枕头垫高了我的脚踝。

sentences.en: Access to advanced training can elevate professional standards and improve the quality of public services.
sentences.zh: 获得进阶培训的机会能够提升专业标准，并改善公共服务质量。

meaning.en: the height of a place above sea level

sentences.en: The elevation of the mountain is 3,000 meters.
sentences.zh: 这座山的海拔是3000米。

sentences.en: High elevation can cause altitude sickness.
sentences.zh: 高海拔可能导致高原反应。

meaning.en: a device that moves up and down between floors of a building

sentences.en: We take the elevator to the top.
sentences.zh: 我们乘电梯到顶层。

sentences.en: Installing elevators in older apartment buildings can significantly improve accessibility for elderly residents and people with disabilities.
sentences.zh: 在老旧公寓楼中安装电梯可以显著方便老年居民和残障人士出入。

meaning.en: the number 11

sentences.en: There are eleven players on a football team.
sentences.zh: 一支足球队有十一名队员。

sentences.en: The meeting will start at eleven o'clock.
sentences.zh: 会议将在十一点开始。

meaning.en: coming after the tenth and before the twelfth; being number 11 in a series

sentences.en: She lives on the eleventh floor.
sentences.zh: 她住在十一楼。

sentences.en: This is the eleventh time he has called today.
sentences.zh: 这是他今天第十一次打电话了。

meaning.en: the eleventh item in a series; one of eleven equal parts

sentences.en: He was the eleventh to arrive.
sentences.zh: 他是第十一个到的。

meaning.zh: 小精灵（故事中的小型魔法生物）
meaning.en: a small magical creature in stories

sentences.en: The little elf hid behind the tree.
sentences.zh: 小精灵躲在了树后面。

sentences.en: In the story, an elf helps the poor shoemaker finish his work.
sentences.zh: 在故事中，一个小精灵帮助贫穷的鞋匠完成工作。

meaning.en: to get information or a reaction from someone

sentences.en: Good questions elicit honest answers.
sentences.zh: 好的问题能引出诚实的回答。

sentences.en: Teachers can use open questions to elicit detailed responses and encourage independent thinking in the classroom.
sentences.zh: 教师可以用开放式问题引导学生详细回答，并鼓励他们在课堂上独立思考。

meaning.en: having the right qualifications or meeting the conditions to do or receive something

sentences.en: She is eligible for the prize.
sentences.zh: 她有资格获得这个奖项。

sentences.en: Only students who have completed the required courses are eligible to apply for the scholarship.
sentences.zh: 只有完成规定课程的学生才有资格申请这项奖学金。

meaning.en: to completely remove or get rid of something

sentences.en: We should eliminate waste in this process.
sentences.zh: 这个净水器能去除自来水中的异味。

sentences.en: Improved public transport could eliminate the need for many urban residents to own a private car.
sentences.zh: 改善公共交通可以使许多城市居民不再需要拥有私家车。

meaning.en: the complete removal of something unwanted or unnecessary

sentences.en: Regular cleaning helps with the elimination of unpleasant kitchen smells.
sentences.zh: 定期清洁有助于消除厨房里的难闻气味。

sentences.en: The elimination of unnecessary packaging could significantly reduce household waste and lower the environmental impact of shopping.
sentences.zh: 消除不必要的包装可以显著减少生活垃圾，降低购物对环境的影响。

meaning.en: a small group of people with the most power, wealth, or skill in a society

sentences.en: The country is run by a small political elite.
sentences.zh: 这个国家由一小群政治精英管理。

sentences.en: Only the elite of the sport can compete at this level.
sentences.zh: 只有这项运动的精英才能在这个水平上竞争。

meaning.en: belonging to or used by a small, powerful, or highly skilled group

sentences.en: She joined an elite sports team at school.
sentences.zh: 她在学校加入了一支精英运动队。

sentences.en: The university is known for its elite research programs.
sentences.zh: 这所大学以其精英研究项目而闻名。

meaning.en: shaped like an ellipse; oval

sentences.en: The planet moves in an elliptical orbit around the sun.
sentences.zh: 这颗行星沿椭圆轨道绕太阳运行。

sentences.en: The mirror has an elliptical frame that makes the room look wider.
sentences.zh: 这面镜子有一个椭圆形边框，使房间看起来更宽敞。

meaning.en: using few words and therefore sometimes difficult to understand

sentences.en: His elliptical remarks left us guessing what he really meant.
sentences.zh: 他隐晦的言辞让我们猜测他真正的意思。

meaning.en: the ability to speak or write in a fluent and persuasive way

sentences.en: Her eloquence impressed everyone at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 她的雄辩给会议上的每个人留下了深刻印象。

sentences.en: The politician's eloquence helped him win public support.
sentences.zh: 这位政治家的口才帮助他赢得了公众的支持。

meaning.en: able to speak or write in a clear, powerful, and persuasive way

sentences.en: Her eloquent speech moved the crowd.
sentences.zh: 她那富有感染力的演讲打动了人群。

sentences.en: The speaker offered an eloquent defence of public libraries as essential spaces for lifelong learning.
sentences.zh: 演讲者有力地论证了公共图书馆作为终身学习重要场所的价值。

meaning.en: other; different from this; in addition

sentences.en: I do not want anything else.
sentences.zh: 我不想要别的了。

sentences.en: Governments must improve public transport, or else growing traffic congestion may undermine the economic benefits of urban development.
sentences.zh: 政府必须改善公共交通，否则日益严重的交通拥堵可能削弱城市发展带来的经济效益。

meaning.en: in, at, or to another place

sentences.en: If it is full, we can sit elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 如果这里满了，我们可以坐到别处。

sentences.en: When local housing becomes unaffordable, young workers often move elsewhere in search of better living conditions.
sentences.zh: 当本地住房变得难以负担时，年轻劳动者往往会迁往别处，寻找更好的生活条件。

meaning.zh: 躲避；逃避（尤指巧妙地逃脱）
meaning.en: to escape from someone or something, especially in a clever way

sentences.en: The thief tried to elude the police.
sentences.zh: 小偷试图躲避警察。

sentences.en: The meaning of the poem eludes me.
sentences.zh: 我无法理解这首诗的含义。

meaning.zh: 难以捉摸的；难以找到（或抓住、理解）的
meaning.en: difficult to find, catch, or understand

sentences.en: The answer to the puzzle is elusive.
sentences.zh: 这个谜题的答案难以捉摸。

sentences.en: Despite years of research, a cure for the disease remains elusive.
sentences.zh: 尽管经过多年研究，这种疾病的治愈方法仍然难以找到。

meaning.en: a message sent electronically from one computer to another

sentences.en: Send an email to your teacher.
sentences.zh: 给你的老师发一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: Although email enables rapid communication, excessive messages can distract employees and reduce productivity at work.
sentences.zh: 虽然电子邮件可以实现快速沟通，但过多的邮件会分散员工注意力，降低工作效率。

meaning.en: to send a message to someone electronically

sentences.en: Please email me the photos.
sentences.zh: 请把照片通过电子邮件发给我。

sentences.en: She emailed the report to her manager before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 她在会议前把报告通过电子邮件发给了经理。

meaning.zh: 散发；发出（气味、热、光、声音等）
meaning.en: to come out from a source; to emit or send forth (a smell, heat, light, sound, etc.)

sentences.en: Heat will emanate from the stove.
sentences.zh: 热量会从炉子散发出来。

sentences.en: A strong smell of coffee emanated from the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 一股浓烈的咖啡味从厨房里散发出来。

meaning.zh: 解放；使不受控制或束缚
meaning.en: to free someone from control or bondage

sentences.en: The law will emancipate the bonded workers.
sentences.zh: 这项法律将解放那些抵债劳工。

sentences.en: Education can emancipate people from poverty and ignorance.
sentences.zh: 教育能使人们摆脱贫困和无知。

meaning.en: a raised bank supporting transport routes or holding back water

sentences.en: We walked along the embankment beside the swollen river.
sentences.zh: 我们沿着涨水的河流旁的堤岸散步。

sentences.en: Strengthening the river embankment could protect nearby homes from flooding as extreme rainfall becomes more frequent.
sentences.zh: 随着极端降雨日益频繁，加固河堤可以保护附近住宅免受洪水侵袭。

meaning.en: an official ban on trade or other commercial activity with a particular country

sentences.en: The embargo stopped oil from leaving the country.
sentences.zh: 禁运阻止了石油运出该国。

sentences.en: The United Nations imposed an arms embargo on the region.
sentences.zh: 联合国对该地区实施了武器禁运。

meaning.en: to get on a ship or plane; to start something new

sentences.en: We embark at six in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我们早上六点上船。

sentences.en: Before students embark on professional training, they should consider both their interests and future employment opportunities.
sentences.zh: 学生在开始职业培训前，应兼顾自身兴趣和未来就业机会。

meaning.en: to make someone feel shy, awkward, or ashamed

sentences.en: Do not embarrass your friend in class.
sentences.zh: 不要在课堂上让你的朋友难堪。

sentences.en: Correcting every mistake publicly can embarrass language learners and discourage them from participating in classroom discussions.
sentences.zh: 公开纠正每一个错误会让语言学习者感到尴尬，并使他们不愿参与课堂讨论。

meaning.en: feeling ashamed, nervous, or uncomfortable in a social situation

sentences.en: I felt embarrassed when my phone rang during dinner.
sentences.zh: 吃饭时手机响了，我感到很尴尬。

sentences.en: Students may feel embarrassed about making mistakes, so teachers should create a supportive classroom environment.
sentences.zh: 学生可能因犯错而感到难为情，因此教师应营造支持性的课堂环境。

meaning.zh: 令人尴尬的；使人难堪的
meaning.en: Making someone feel awkward, ashamed, or uncomfortable

sentences.en: It was embarrassing when my phone rang during the ceremony.
sentences.zh: 典礼进行时我的手机响了，真让人尴尬。

sentences.en: Students may avoid asking questions if they believe that making mistakes in front of classmates is embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 如果学生觉得在同学面前犯错很丢脸，他们可能会避免提问。

meaning.en: an uncomfortable feeling caused by awkwardness or fear of others' judgment

sentences.en: I blushed with embarrassment when I forgot my neighbour's name.
sentences.zh: 我忘了邻居的名字，尴尬得脸都红了。

sentences.en: Fear of embarrassment may prevent language learners from practising their speaking skills in front of others.
sentences.zh: 害怕尴尬可能使语言学习者不敢在他人面前练习口语。

meaning.zh: 大使馆；大使馆全体人员
meaning.en: the official residence or offices of an ambassador and its staff in a foreign country

sentences.en: We waited at the embassy for our visas.
sentences.zh: 在国外丢失护照后，我联系了大使馆。

sentences.en: An embassy provides assistance to citizens overseas and helps maintain diplomatic relations between the two countries.
sentences.zh: 大使馆为海外公民提供援助，并帮助维持两国间的外交关系。

meaning.zh: 嵌入；把…牢牢固定于…中；使融入
meaning.en: to fix something firmly inside something else; to make something an integral part of a larger whole

sentences.en: They embed the post in concrete.
sentences.zh: 他们把柱子嵌入混凝土中。

sentences.en: Schools should embed environmental awareness in everyday lessons rather than discuss sustainability only on special occasions.
sentences.zh: 学校应将环保意识融入日常课程，而不是只在特殊场合讨论可持续发展。

meaning.en: to represent or express an idea, quality, or feeling in a clear or concrete form

sentences.en: This song can embody her hope.
sentences.zh: 这首歌能体现她的希望。

sentences.en: Public buildings should embody the values of inclusion by providing accessible spaces for people with different needs.
sentences.zh: 公共建筑应为有不同需求的人提供无障碍空间，以体现包容的价值观。

meaning.en: to hold someone in your arms to express love or sympathy, or as a greeting

sentences.en: The mother and child embrace at the gate.
sentences.zh: 母亲和孩子在门口拥抱。

sentences.en: Schools that embrace new technology should also ensure that all students have equal access to digital resources.
sentences.zh: 欣然采用新技术的学校也应确保所有学生都能平等获取数字资源。

meaning.en: to accept something new or different willingly and enthusiastically

sentences.en: Many young people embrace online learning as a flexible way to study.
sentences.zh: 许多年轻人欣然接受在线学习作为一种灵活的学习方式。

sentences.en: The company decided to embrace change rather than resist it, which helped it stay competitive.
sentences.zh: 公司决定欣然接受变革而不是抵制它，这帮助它保持了竞争力。

meaning.en: to sew patterns on cloth

sentences.en: She likes to embroider flowers on cloth.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢在布上绣花。

sentences.en: Local artisans embroider traditional patterns on clothing, preserving cultural knowledge while creating products that appeal to visitors.
sentences.zh: 当地工匠在衣物上绣上传统图案，在保存文化知识的同时制作吸引游客的产品。

meaning.en: The craft of decorating cloth with needle and thread.

sentences.en: I practise embroidery by stitching flowers onto plain cushions.
sentences.zh: 我在素色靠垫上绣花来练习刺绣。

sentences.en: Community embroidery workshops can preserve traditional skills while creating opportunities for different generations to learn together.
sentences.zh: 社区刺绣工作坊既能保护传统技艺，也能为不同年龄的人创造共同学习的机会。

meaning.en: An animal or plant in the earliest stage of development before birth or hatching

sentences.en: We could see the chick embryo inside the egg.
sentences.zh: 我们能看到鸡蛋里的小鸡胚胎。

sentences.en: Researchers study how environmental conditions affect embryo development to improve the breeding of endangered species.
sentences.zh: 研究人员研究环境条件如何影响胚胎发育，以改善濒危物种的繁育。

meaning.zh: 胚胎的；萌芽期的，初期的
meaning.en: relating to an embryo; in an early stage of development

sentences.en: The plan is still in an embryonic stage.
sentences.zh: 这个计划仍处于萌芽阶段。

sentences.en: Embryonic stem cells can develop into many different cell types.
sentences.zh: 胚胎干细胞可以发育成许多不同类型的细胞。

meaning.en: to come out or become known, especially from a hidden or enclosed place

sentences.en: Rabbits emerge from the hole at night.
sentences.zh: 一只小兔子从花园棚屋底下钻了出来。

sentences.en: New employment opportunities may emerge as governments invest more heavily in renewable energy infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 随着政府加大对可再生能源基础设施的投资，新的就业机会可能会出现。

meaning.en: the process of appearing or becoming known, especially for the first time

sentences.en: The emergence of new technologies has changed the way we live.
sentences.zh: 新技术的出现改变了我们的生活方式。

sentences.en: Scientists are studying the emergence of new patterns in the data.
sentences.zh: 科学家正在研究数据中新模式的出现。

meaning.en: a sudden serious and dangerous event or situation that needs immediate action

sentences.en: Call for help in an emergency.
sentences.zh: 遇到紧急情况时要呼救。

sentences.en: Governments should invest in emergency services to ensure that communities receive rapid assistance during natural disasters.
sentences.zh: 政府应投资应急服务，确保社区在自然灾害期间迅速获得援助。

meaning.zh: 移居国外者；移民（指迁出者）
meaning.en: a person who leaves a country to live elsewhere

sentences.en: The emigrant wrote home often.
sentences.zh: 这位移居国外者经常写信回家。

sentences.en: Emigrants often maintain strong connections with their countries of origin through family visits and financial support.
sentences.zh: 移居国外的人常通过探亲和经济援助，与原籍国保持紧密联系。

meaning.en: to leave your country to live elsewhere

sentences.en: They plan to emigrate next year.
sentences.zh: 他们计划明年移居国外。

sentences.en: Skilled workers may emigrate when their home countries offer limited opportunities for professional development.
sentences.zh: 当本国提供的职业发展机会有限时，技术人才可能会移居国外。

meaning.zh: 杰出的；著名的；受人尊敬的
meaning.en: famous and respected, especially in a particular profession or field

sentences.en: An eminent scientist opened the meeting.
sentences.zh: 一位杰出的科学家主持了会议。

sentences.en: Universities often invite eminent researchers to share their findings and inspire students to pursue academic careers.
sentences.zh: 大学常邀请杰出的研究人员分享研究成果，激励学生从事学术工作。

meaning.en: To a very great degree, especially in a positive way.

sentences.en: Your spare room looks eminently suitable for a study.
sentences.zh: 你那间空房看起来非常适合用作书房。

sentences.en: Improving insulation is an eminently sensible way to reduce household energy consumption and heating costs.
sentences.zh: 改善隔热保温是降低家庭能耗和取暖费用的非常明智的方法。

meaning.en: A substance released into the environment, especially a polluting gas; the act of releasing such substances.

sentences.en: The mechanic checked my car's emissions this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，修理工检查了我汽车的尾气排放。

sentences.en: Governments can reduce carbon emissions by investing in renewable energy and improving public transport networks.
sentences.zh: 政府可以通过投资可再生能源和改善公共交通网络来减少碳排放。

meaning.zh: 发出（光、热、声音等）；排放（气体、辐射等）
meaning.en: to produce and send out (light, heat, sound, gas, etc.)

sentences.en: The machine can emit a loud warning sound.
sentences.zh: 这台机器能发出响亮的警报声。

sentences.en: Factories that emit harmful gases should install cleaner technology to reduce their impact on public health.
sentences.zh: 排放有害气体的工厂应安装更清洁的技术设备，以减少对公众健康的影响。

meaning.en: a strong feeling such as love, anger, or fear

sentences.en: Her face shows a strong emotion.
sentences.zh: 她的脸上流露出强烈的情绪。

sentences.en: Teaching children to recognise and manage emotion can improve their relationships and support long-term mental health.
sentences.zh: 教孩子识别和管理情绪，可以改善他们的人际关系，并促进长期心理健康。

meaning.en: Related to feelings rather than thoughts or physical needs.

sentences.en: Her friends gave her emotional support during the move.
sentences.zh: 搬家期间，她的朋友们在情感上给予了她支持。

sentences.en: Schools should support children's emotional development alongside academic progress to promote their long-term well-being.
sentences.zh: 学校应在促进学业进步的同时支持儿童的情感发展，以增进他们的长期福祉。

meaning.en: the ability to understand and share another person's feelings

sentences.en: Good doctors show empathy to patients.
sentences.zh: 好医生对病人表现出同理心。

sentences.en: Reading fiction can help children develop empathy for people whose lives are different from their own.
sentences.zh: 阅读小说能帮助孩子对那些生活与自己不同的人产生同理心。

meaning.en: the male ruler of an empire

sentences.en: The emperor sits on a gold chair.
sentences.zh: 皇帝坐在一把金椅子上。

sentences.en: The emperor expanded trade routes, allowing goods and cultural practices to spread across the empire.
sentences.zh: 这位皇帝拓展了贸易路线，使商品和文化习俗得以在帝国各地传播。

meaning.en: special importance or attention given to something

sentences.en: The teacher put emphasis on reading.

meaning.en: to give special importance or attention to something

sentences.en: Teachers emphasize reading every day.
sentences.zh: 老师们每天都强调阅读。

sentences.en: The report emphasizes the need for better public transport in cities.
sentences.zh: 该报告强调城市需要更好的公共交通。

meaning.zh: 强调的；断然的；语气强烈的
meaning.en: expressed with force or emphasis; definite and strong

sentences.en: He gave an emphatic no to the plan.

meaning.en: a group of countries ruled by one person or government

sentences.en: The empire lasted many long years.
sentences.zh: 这个帝国延续了许多年。

sentences.en: The Roman Empire once controlled vast territories across Europe and North Africa.
sentences.zh: 罗马帝国曾控制欧洲和北非的大片领土。

meaning.zh: 实证的；基于观察或实验的
meaning.en: based on observation or experiments rather than theory alone

sentences.en: Our garden trial provided empirical evidence that compost helps plants.
sentences.zh: 我们的花园试验提供了堆肥有益植物的实证依据。

sentences.en: Education policies should be supported by empirical research rather than assumptions about how children learn.
sentences.zh: 教育政策应以实证研究为依据，而不是依赖对儿童学习方式的假设。

meaning.en: to give someone a job and pay them for their work

sentences.en: The bakery employs three people from our neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 这家面包店雇用了我们街区的三个人。

sentences.en: Teachers can employ a range of practical activities to help students understand complex scientific concepts.
sentences.zh: 教师可以采用一系列实践活动，帮助学生理解复杂的科学概念。

meaning.en: a person who is paid to work for a company or organization

sentences.en: Each employee wears a name card.
sentences.zh: 每位员工都佩戴名牌。

sentences.en: Employers should provide every employee with appropriate training to maintain a safe and productive workplace.
sentences.zh: 雇主应为每位员工提供适当培训，以保持工作场所的安全和高效。

meaning.en: a person or company that pays people to work for them

sentences.en: My employer is kind and fair.
sentences.zh: 我的雇主善良又公平。

sentences.en: Employers can improve staff retention by offering fair wages, flexible schedules, and opportunities for professional development.
sentences.zh: 雇主可以通过提供公平的薪资、灵活的工作安排和职业发展机会来提高员工留任率。

meaning.en: a job; the state of having a job

sentences.en: She found employment at a small shop.
sentences.zh: 她在一家小商店找到了工作。

sentences.en: Investment in renewable energy can create employment opportunities while helping countries meet their climate targets.
sentences.zh: 投资可再生能源可以创造就业机会，同时帮助各国实现气候目标。

meaning.en: to give someone the power or authority to do something

sentences.en: The law will empower local schools.
sentences.zh: 这项法律将授权地方学校。

sentences.en: Access to reliable information can empower citizens to make informed decisions about their health.
sentences.zh: 获取可靠信息可以使公民有能力对自身健康作出明智决定。

meaning.en: a female ruler of an empire, or the wife of an emperor

sentences.en: The empress wore a heavy gold crown.
sentences.zh: 女皇戴着一顶沉重的金冠。

sentences.en: The empress ruled the empire wisely for many years.
sentences.zh: 这位女皇明智地统治帝国多年。

meaning.en: with nothing inside

sentences.en: The empty box has no toys.
sentences.zh: 这个空盒子里没有玩具。

sentences.en: Converting empty office buildings into affordable housing could help cities address shortages without expanding into surrounding countryside.
sentences.zh: 将空置办公楼改造成可负担住房，可以帮助城市缓解住房短缺，而不必向周边乡村扩张。

meaning.en: to try to be as good as someone or something by copying their behavior or achievements

sentences.en: Young players emulate their football heroes.
sentences.zh: 年轻球员们仿效他们的足球英雄。

sentences.en: Many startups try to emulate the success of large tech companies.
sentences.zh: 许多初创公司试图仿效大型科技公司的成功。

meaning.en: to make someone able to do something, or to make something possible

sentences.en: This app enables students to learn English anywhere.
sentences.zh: 这个应用程序使学生能够在任何地方学习英语。

sentences.en: The new policy enables small businesses to get easier access to loans.
sentences.zh: 新政策使小企业更容易获得贷款。

meaning.en: to make a bill into law

sentences.en: Parliament will enact the new law.
sentences.zh: 议会将颁布这项新法律。

sentences.en: Governments should enact legislation that protects vulnerable workers without placing excessive financial burdens on small businesses.
sentences.zh: 政府应制定保护弱势劳动者的法律，同时避免给小企业带来过重的经济负担。

meaning.en: to attract and delight someone greatly

sentences.en: The music will enchant the whole crowd.
sentences.zh: 这音乐会让全场观众陶醉。

sentences.en: Traditional storytelling can enchant young audiences while introducing them to the cultural heritage of their communities.
sentences.zh: 传统故事讲述既能吸引年轻观众，也能让他们了解所在社区的文化遗产。

meaning.en: To form a circle around someone or something.

sentences.en: Tall trees encircle the small pond behind our house.
sentences.zh: 高大的树木环绕着我们屋后的小池塘。

sentences.en: Green belts that encircle urban areas can protect wildlife habitats and limit uncontrolled development.
sentences.zh: 环绕城区的绿化带可以保护野生动物栖息地，并限制无序开发。

meaning.zh: 飞地；（与周围环境不同的）独立小区域
meaning.en: a small area of land or a group of people that is different from the surrounding area

sentences.en: The town is a quiet enclave.
sentences.zh: 这个小镇是一个安静的小天地。

sentences.en: The immigrant community formed a cultural enclave within the city.
sentences.zh: 这个移民群体在城市中形成了一个文化飞地。

meaning.en: to include something in a letter or package

sentences.en: Please enclose a photo with your letter.
sentences.zh: 请在信中附上一张照片。

sentences.en: Applicants should enclose copies of their qualifications when submitting a paper application for the scholarship.
sentences.zh: 申请人提交纸质奖学金申请时，应随附资格证明文件的复印件。

meaning.en: to surround something with a wall, fence, etc.

sentences.en: A low stone wall encloses our sunny back garden.
sentences.zh: 一道低矮的石墙围着我们阳光充足的后花园。

sentences.en: The ancient city was enclosed by thick walls to protect its residents from attack.
sentences.zh: 这座古城被厚厚的城墙围住，以保护居民免受攻击。

meaning.en: An area surrounded by a fence, wall, or other barrier.

sentences.en: The goats rested in their enclosure beside the barn.
sentences.zh: 山羊在谷仓旁的围栏里休息。

sentences.en: Wildlife parks should provide each enclosure with enough space for animals to display natural behaviour.
sentences.zh: 野生动物园应为每个围场提供足够空间，让动物展现自然行为。

meaning.en: to include or cover a range of things

sentences.en: The course will encompass art history.
sentences.zh: 这门课程将涵盖艺术史。

sentences.en: The new policy encompasses a wide range of environmental issues.
sentences.zh: 新政策涵盖了广泛的环境问题。

meaning.zh: 遇到；遭遇（问题、困难等）；偶然碰到（某人）
meaning.en: to experience something, especially problems or difficulties; to meet someone unexpectedly

sentences.en: We may encounter problems on the long trip.
sentences.zh: 长途旅行中我们可能会遇到问题。

sentences.en: Students studying abroad may encounter cultural differences that challenge their assumptions about communication and social behaviour.
sentences.zh: 留学生可能遇到文化差异，从而反思自己对沟通和社会行为的原有看法。

meaning.en: to give someone confidence or support to do something

sentences.en: Teachers encourage us to try again.
sentences.zh: 老师鼓励我们再试一次。

sentences.en: Local governments can encourage cycling by providing safer routes and secure bicycle parking near workplaces.
sentences.zh: 地方政府可以通过提供更安全的路线和工作场所附近的安全自行车停车设施来鼓励骑行。

meaning.en: words or actions that give someone confidence or hope to do something

sentences.en: Her encouragement gave me the confidence to try again.
sentences.zh: 她的鼓励给了我再次尝试的信心。

sentences.en: The teacher's constant encouragement helped the shy student participate more in class.
sentences.zh: 老师不断的鼓励帮助这个害羞的学生更多地参与课堂活动。

meaning.en: To gradually take over another's space, time, or rights.

sentences.en: The neighbour's bushes are beginning to encroach on our garden.
sentences.zh: 邻居家的灌木开始长到我们花园里来了。

sentences.en: As new housing developments encroach on wetlands, local wildlife loses essential breeding grounds and sources of food.
sentences.zh: 随着新住宅开发项目逐步侵占湿地，当地野生动物失去了重要的繁殖地和食物来源。

meaning.en: A reference work containing information about many subjects or one field

sentences.en: We found a dinosaur picture in the encyclopaedia.
sentences.zh: 我们在百科全书里找到了一张恐龙图片。

sentences.en: An online encyclopaedia provides a useful starting point for research, but students should verify information using reliable sources.
sentences.zh: 在线百科全书为研究提供了有用的起点，但学生应通过可靠来源核实信息。

meaning.en: a book or set of books giving information on many areas of knowledge

sentences.en: I looked up whales in the encyclopedia.
sentences.zh: 我在百科全书里查阅了鲸鱼。

sentences.en: An online encyclopedia offers convenient background information, but students should verify important claims using reliable academic sources.
sentences.zh: 在线百科全书便于查询背景信息，但学生应使用可靠的学术来源核实重要论断。

meaning.en: the last part or final point of something

sentences.en: The story comes to an end.
sentences.zh: 这个故事结束了。

sentences.en: At the end of the meeting, the manager summarized the main decisions.
sentences.zh: 会议结束时，经理总结了主要决定。

meaning.en: to finish or stop something

sentences.en: The film ends at nine o'clock.
sentences.zh: 电影九点结束。

sentences.en: Governments should aim to end extreme poverty by improving access to education and secure employment.
sentences.zh: 政府应通过改善教育机会和稳定就业的可及性，努力消除极端贫困。

meaning.zh: 最终处于（某种状态或地方）；结果是
meaning.en: to finally be in a particular state or place, often unexpectedly

sentences.en: They end up after class.

meaning.en: to put someone or something in danger

sentences.en: Pollution can endanger wildlife.
sentences.zh: 污染会危及野生动物。

sentences.en: The new law is intended to protect endangered species from being further endangered by illegal hunting.
sentences.zh: 这项新法律旨在保护濒危物种，使其免遭非法狩猎的进一步危害。

meaning.en: at risk of becoming extinct

sentences.en: Pandas are an endangered animal.
sentences.zh: 熊猫是濒危动物。

sentences.en: The government has introduced new laws to protect endangered species.
sentences.zh: 政府已出台新法律来保护濒危物种。

meaning.en: to make someone liked or loved

sentences.en: Kindness will endear her to the class.
sentences.zh: 她的善良会使她受到全班同学的喜爱。

sentences.en: His sense of humor endeared him to his colleagues.
sentences.zh: 他的幽默感使同事们很喜欢他。

meaning.en: To try hard to achieve something

sentences.en: We endeavor to answer every message before dinner.
sentences.zh: 我们尽力在晚饭前回复每一条消息。

sentences.en: Universities should endeavor to make higher education accessible to students from a wider range of backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 大学应努力让更多不同背景的学生有机会接受高等教育。

meaning.en: A serious effort to achieve something.

sentences.en: Growing vegetables together became our family's latest endeavour.
sentences.zh: 一起种菜成了我们全家最近尝试的新事情。

sentences.en: Governments should endeavour to make reliable public transport accessible to people in remote communities.
sentences.zh: 政府应努力让偏远社区的居民也能使用可靠的公共交通。

meaning.en: The final part of something, such as a story, film, or event.

sentences.en: The film has a happy ending.
sentences.zh: 这部电影有一个幸福的结局。

sentences.en: An ambiguous ending can encourage readers to question their assumptions and consider alternative interpretations of a novel.
sentences.zh: 含义不明确的结局可以促使读者质疑自己的假设，并考虑对小说的其他解读。

meaning.en: Having no end, or seeming to continue forever.

sentences.en: The line outside the pool seemed endless.
sentences.zh: 游泳池外的队伍似乎怎么也排不到头。

sentences.en: Although online platforms offer endless entertainment, excessive screen time may reduce opportunities for meaningful social interaction.
sentences.zh: 虽然网络平台提供无穷无尽的娱乐，但过多的屏幕时间可能减少有意义的社交机会。

meaning.en: to say publicly that you support or approve of someone or something, often in an advertisement

sentences.en: The star will endorse the product.
sentences.zh: 这位明星将为该产品代言。

sentences.en: Several major companies have endorsed the new environmental policy.
sentences.zh: 几家大公司已公开支持这项新环保政策。

meaning.en: public support or approval for someone or something, often given by a famous person or an organization

sentences.en: The singer gave her endorsement to the new charity campaign.
sentences.zh: 这位歌手公开支持这项新的慈善活动。

sentences.en: The product's success was largely due to a celebrity endorsement.
sentences.zh: 该产品的成功在很大程度上归功于一位名人的代言。

meaning.en: to give someone a particular quality or ability

sentences.en: They endow the school with funds.
sentences.zh: 她的家人在当地学院捐资设立了一项奖学金。

sentences.en: Private donations can endow research centres that investigate long-term solutions to urgent public health problems.
sentences.zh: 私人捐款可以资助研究中心，为紧迫的公共卫生问题探索长期解决方案。

meaning.en: to give money or property to an institution or person, especially to provide a regular income
The ability to continue despite tiredness, pain, or difficulty.

sentences.en: Swimming every morning has really improved my endurance.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨游泳确实增强了我的耐力。

sentences.en: Regular physical activity builds endurance and helps people manage the demands of an increasingly sedentary lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 经常运动能增强耐力，帮助人们应对日益久坐的生活方式带来的挑战。

meaning.zh: 忍受，忍耐（困难或不愉快的事）
meaning.en: to suffer something difficult or unpleasant patiently

sentences.en: They had to endure the long cold winter.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不忍受漫长寒冷的冬天。

sentences.en: Communities in dry regions must endure prolonged water shortages as climate patterns become less predictable.
sentences.zh: 随着气候模式变得更难预测，干旱地区的社区不得不承受长期缺水。

meaning.en: a person who hates someone or wants to harm them

sentences.en: In the story, the prince and his enemy became friends.
sentences.zh: 故事里，王子和他的敌人成了朋友。

sentences.en: Public distrust can become an enemy of effective environmental policy, particularly when governments fail to explain their decisions.
sentences.zh: 公众的不信任可能成为有效环境政策的大敌，尤其是在政府未能解释其决策时。

meaning.en: Having or showing plenty of energy and enthusiasm.

sentences.en: Our energetic little dog chased the ball around the garden.
sentences.zh: 我们那只精力旺盛的小狗在花园里追着球跑。

sentences.en: Regular physical activity can help office workers feel more energetic and maintain concentration throughout the day.
sentences.zh: 经常运动有助于办公室职员更有活力，并在一天中保持专注。

meaning.en: to make someone feel more energetic or to give something more energy

sentences.en: A good breakfast will energize you for the whole morning.
sentences.zh: 一顿丰盛的早餐会让你整个上午都精力充沛。

sentences.en: The new coach knows how to energize the team before an important match.
sentences.zh: 新教练知道如何在重要比赛前激发全队的活力。

meaning.en: the physical or mental power needed to be active or to do work

sentences.en: Running gives me a lot of energy.
sentences.zh: 跑步让我充满精力。

sentences.en: Investing in renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels while creating new employment opportunities.
sentences.zh: 投资可再生能源可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，同时创造新的就业机会。

meaning.en: to make people obey a law or rule, or to make sure that something is done

sentences.en: Police enforce the speed limit on this road.
sentences.zh: 警察在这条路上执行限速规定。

sentences.en: Governments must enforce environmental regulations consistently if they want industries to reduce pollution and protect public health.
sentences.zh: 政府若希望各行业减少污染、保护公众健康，就必须始终如一地执行环境法规。

meaning.en: To attract someone's attention and keep them interested or involved.

sentences.en: The puppet show engaged even the youngest children.
sentences.zh: 这场木偶戏连最小的孩子都吸引住了。

sentences.en: Schools should encourage students to engage in community activities that develop cooperation and a sense of responsibility.
sentences.zh: 学校应鼓励学生参与社区活动，培养合作能力和责任感。

meaning.en: having agreed to marry

sentences.en: The engaged couple chose a wedding date.
sentences.zh: 这对已订婚的情侣选定了婚礼日期。

sentences.en: Students who are actively engaged in classroom discussions often develop stronger communication and critical thinking skills.
sentences.zh: 积极参与课堂讨论的学生往往能培养更强的沟通和批判性思维能力。

meaning.en: actively involved in or giving attention to something

sentences.en: Students who are actively engaged in classroom discussions often develop stronger communication and critical thinking skills.
sentences.zh: 积极参与课堂讨论的学生往往能培养更强的沟通和批判性思维能力。

meaning.en: an agreement to marry someone

sentences.en: They announced their engagement last week.
sentences.zh: 他们上周宣布了订婚。

sentences.en: Her engagement ring was a family heirloom.
sentences.zh: 她的订婚戒指是传家宝。

meaning.zh: 产生；引起（某种感觉或情况）
meaning.en: to cause a feeling or situation to exist

sentences.en: Kind acts engender trust.
sentences.zh: 善意的行为能产生信任。

sentences.en: The new policy may engender resentment among workers.
sentences.zh: 这项新政策可能会在工人中引起不满。

meaning.en: a machine that uses fuel or electricity to produce power and make a vehicle move

sentences.en: The engine makes the car move.
sentences.zh: 发动机使汽车行驶。

sentences.en: Cleaner engine technology can reduce air pollution, although expanding public transport remains essential for sustainable urban travel.
sentences.zh: 更清洁的发动机技术可以减少空气污染，但扩大公共交通仍是实现城市可持续出行的关键。

meaning.en: a person who designs, constructs, and maintains machines or structures

sentences.en: The engineer builds a strong bridge.
sentences.zh: 这位工程师建造了一座坚固的桥。

sentences.en: Engineers can reduce urban energy consumption by designing buildings that require less heating and cooling.
sentences.zh: 工程师可以通过设计供暖和制冷需求更低的建筑来减少城市能源消耗。

meaning.en: the application of science and mathematics to design and build machines, structures, and systems

sentences.en: My cousin studies engineering and builds small robots at home.
sentences.zh: 我的表哥学工程，平时在家制作小型机器人。

sentences.en: Advances in engineering have enabled cities to build bridges that withstand extreme weather and carry heavier traffic.
sentences.zh: 工程技术的进步使城市能够建造抵御极端天气、承载更大交通量的桥梁。

meaning.en: a country in the UK, located in the southern part of Great Britain

sentences.en: My cousin lives in a quiet village in England.
sentences.zh: 我的表亲住在英格兰一个安静的村庄里。

sentences.en: Historic towns in England attract international visitors, creating jobs while increasing pressure on local infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 英格兰的历史城镇吸引着国际游客，既创造了就业机会，也增加了当地基础设施的压力。

meaning.en: the language of England and many other countries

sentences.en: She is learning English at school.
sentences.zh: 她在学校学习英语。

sentences.en: Learning English can widen access to international research and help students communicate across cultural boundaries.
sentences.zh: 学习英语可以拓宽获取国际研究成果的渠道，帮助学生跨文化交流。

meaning.en: relating to England, its people, or its language

sentences.en: He enjoys English literature.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢英国文学。

meaning.zh: 英格兰男子（尤指土生土长的英格兰人）
meaning.en: a man who is from England, especially one born there

sentences.en: The Englishman ordered a cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 那位英格兰男子点了一杯茶。

sentences.en: As an Englishman, he was used to rainy weather.
sentences.zh: 作为英格兰人，他习惯了多雨的天气。

meaning.en: to cut words or a design into a surface

sentences.en: Artists engrave a name on the metal cup.
sentences.zh: 艺术家们在金属杯上刻上名字。

sentences.en: The trophy was engraved with the winner's name.
sentences.zh: 奖杯上刻有获胜者的名字。

meaning.en: to hold all of someone's attention

sentences.en: Good books engross young readers.
sentences.zh: 好书能让年轻读者全神贯注。

sentences.en: She was so engrossed in her work that she didn't hear the phone ring.
sentences.zh: 她太专注于工作，以至于没听到电话响。

meaning.en: to cover or swallow up completely

sentences.en: Flames engulf the old barn.
sentences.zh: 火焰吞没了那座旧谷仓。

sentences.en: The sudden wave engulfed the sandcastle we had built on the beach.
sentences.zh: 突如其来的浪头吞没了我们在沙滩上堆的沙堡。

sentences.en: Rising sea levels could engulf low-lying coastal settlements unless governments invest in effective flood protection.
sentences.zh: 除非政府投资建设有效的防洪设施，否则海平面上升可能淹没地势低洼的沿海居民区。

meaning.en: to improve the quality, value, or strength of something

sentences.en: Practice will enhance your English skills.
sentences.zh: 练习会提高你的英语技能。

sentences.en: Access to green spaces can enhance residents' wellbeing and encourage more active lifestyles in crowded cities.
sentences.zh: 在拥挤的城市中，便利的绿地资源可以提升居民的幸福感，并鼓励更积极的生活方式。

meaning.zh: 谜一般的人或事物；难以理解的事物
meaning.en: a person or thing that is mysterious or difficult to understand

sentences.en: His sudden change remains an enigma.
sentences.zh: 他突然的改变仍然是个谜。

sentences.en: The ancient manuscript is an enigma that scholars have tried to decode for centuries.
sentences.zh: 这份古代手稿是一个谜，学者们数百年来一直试图解读它。

meaning.en: to get pleasure from something

sentences.en: We enjoy the school trip.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢晚饭后在河边散步。

sentences.en: Residents enjoy better health when their neighbourhoods provide safe walking routes and accessible green spaces.
sentences.zh: 社区提供安全的步行路线和便利的绿地时，居民的健康状况会更好。

meaning.en: Giving pleasure or enjoyment; pleasant.

sentences.en: The cooking class was very enjoyable, especially when we made fresh pasta.
sentences.zh: 这堂烹饪课很有趣，尤其是我们制作新鲜意面的时候。

sentences.en: Making physical activity enjoyable can encourage children to develop healthy habits that continue into adulthood.
sentences.zh: 让体育活动充满乐趣，可以鼓励儿童养成延续至成年的健康习惯。

meaning.en: The pleasure you get from doing or experiencing something

sentences.en: My grandfather gets great enjoyment from feeding the birds.
sentences.zh: 我祖父从喂鸟中获得了很大的乐趣。

sentences.en: Schools should encourage reading for enjoyment rather than focusing exclusively on examination performance.
sentences.zh: 学校应鼓励学生享受阅读的乐趣，而不是只关注考试成绩。

meaning.en: to make or become bigger

sentences.en: They enlarge the photo to show more detail.
sentences.zh: 他们把照片放大，以显示更多细节。

sentences.en: The council plans to enlarge the public library to accommodate growing demand for quiet study spaces.
sentences.zh: 市政委员会计划扩建公共图书馆，以满足对安静学习空间日益增长的需求。

meaning.en: to give someone greater knowledge or understanding about something

sentences.en: The talk will enlighten the class.
sentences.zh: 这场讲座将启发全班同学。

sentences.en: Public health campaigns should enlighten citizens about the benefits of vaccination while addressing common concerns respectfully.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生宣传应让公众了解接种疫苗的益处，同时以尊重的态度回应常见顾虑。

meaning.en: the state of understanding something clearly, especially spiritual or intellectual insight; also (capitalized) the 18th-century European intellectual movement

sentences.en: The teacher's explanation brought enlightenment to the confused students.
sentences.zh: 老师的解释让困惑的学生们豁然开朗。

sentences.en: The Enlightenment was a philosophical movement that emphasized reason and individual rights.
sentences.zh: 启蒙运动是一场强调理性与个人权利的哲学运动。

meaning.zh: 入伍；征募；争取（支持、帮助等）
meaning.en: to join the army, or to persuade someone to help or support you

sentences.en: He will enlist in the army.
sentences.zh: 他将参军入伍。

sentences.en: The charity enlisted the support of several local businesses.
sentences.zh: 该慈善机构争取到了几家当地企业的支持。

meaning.en: extremely large in size

sentences.en: An enormous rock blocked the road.
sentences.zh: 一块巨大的岩石挡住了道路。

sentences.en: Rapid urban growth places enormous pressure on housing, transport networks, and other essential public services.
sentences.zh: 城市的快速发展给住房、交通网络及其他基本公共服务带来巨大压力。

meaning.en: to a very great degree or extent

sentences.en: Your help made this difficult move enormously easier.
sentences.zh: 你的帮助让这次艰难的搬家轻松了许多。

sentences.en: Affordable public transport can benefit low-income households enormously by reducing their daily travel costs.
sentences.zh: 价格实惠的公共交通可以降低日常出行成本，使低收入家庭大大受益。

meaning.en: as much or as many as needed

sentences.en: We have enough paper for class.
sentences.zh: 我们的米够今晚所有人吃。

sentences.en: Many rural schools lack enough resources to provide students with a broad range of subjects.
sentences.zh: 许多农村学校缺乏足够的资源，无法为学生开设广泛的课程。

meaning.en: To ask for information about something.

sentences.en: I called the hotel to enquire whether they had any rooms available.
sentences.zh: 我打电话给酒店，询问是否有空房。

sentences.en: Prospective students should enquire about financial support before deciding which university course best suits their needs.
sentences.zh: 有意申请的学生应先询问资助情况，再决定哪门大学课程最适合自己。

meaning.en: A request for information; an official investigation.

sentences.en: The receptionist answered my enquiry about the opening hours.
sentences.zh: 接待员回答了我关于营业时间的询问。

sentences.en: A public enquiry into the transport project could help explain why construction costs rose so sharply.
sentences.zh: 对该交通项目开展公开调查，有助于解释建设成本为何大幅上涨。

meaning.en: to improve the quality or value of something

sentences.en: Travel can enrich your knowledge of the world.
sentences.zh: 旅行能丰富你对世界的了解。

sentences.en: International exchange programmes can enrich students' education by exposing them to different perspectives and teaching methods.
sentences.zh: 国际交流项目能让学生接触不同观点和教学方法，从而丰富他们的教育体验。

meaning.en: To officially join a course or organization, or to register someone for it.

sentences.en: I plan to enrol on a cooking course next month.
sentences.zh: 我打算下个月报名参加烹饪课程。

sentences.en: Governments can encourage adults to enrol in vocational training by offering flexible schedules and financial support.
sentences.zh: 政府可以通过提供灵活的课程安排和经济支持，鼓励成年人报名参加职业培训。

meaning.en: to register or sign up, especially for a course or as a member

sentences.en: Students enroll in the art class each autumn.
sentences.zh: 学生们每年秋天报名参加美术课。

sentences.en: The university plans to enroll more international students next year.
sentences.zh: 这所大学计划明年招收更多国际学生。

meaning.zh: 入学人数；登记人数；注册
meaning.en: the number of people who register for a school, course, or organization; the act of registering

sentences.en: The university has seen a rise in enrollment this year.
sentences.zh: 今年这所大学的入学人数有所增加。

sentences.en: Enrollment for the online course closes at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 这门在线课程的注册将于月底截止。

meaning.zh: 合奏团；合唱团；（全套）服装
meaning.en: a group of musicians, singers, or actors who perform together; a set of clothes worn together

sentences.en: The ensemble played a waltz.
sentences.zh: 合奏团演奏了一首华尔兹。

sentences.en: She wore a striking ensemble of a red coat and black boots.
sentences.zh: 她穿着一套醒目的红色外套和黑色靴子。

meaning.en: to happen after or as a result of something else

sentences.en: A long silence will ensue after the speech.
sentences.zh: 演讲结束后，接着会出现长时间的沉默。

sentences.en: If public services fail to meet growing demand, widespread dissatisfaction may ensue among local residents.
sentences.zh: 如果公共服务无法满足不断增长的需求，当地居民可能随之产生普遍的不满。

meaning.en: to make certain that something happens or is true

sentences.en: Please ensure that the door is locked.
sentences.zh: 请确保门已锁好。

sentences.en: Governments should ensure that affordable public transport is available to residents in both urban and rural areas.
sentences.zh: 政府应确保城市和农村居民都能享有价格实惠的公共交通。

meaning.en: to involve something as a necessary part or consequence

sentences.en: The job will entail long hours.
sentences.zh: 这份工作将需要长时间工作。

sentences.en: Expanding public transport will entail substantial initial costs, although the environmental and social benefits may justify this investment.
sentences.zh: 扩建公共交通必然涉及大量前期费用，但其环境和社会效益可能使这项投资值得。

meaning.en: to go into a place

sentences.en: Please enter the classroom quietly.
sentences.zh: 请安静地进入教室。
